findings.documented: Every request must carry the API key as a query parameter: GET /v1/listings?api_key=IVY26-XXXXXXXXXXXX
findings.actual: Passing api_key as a query parameter returns HTTP 401 with detail 'send your key in the X-API-Key request header, not as a query parameter'. The API key is strictly required in the X-API-Key HTTP header.
findings.how_found: Issued GET /v1/listings?api_key=... and received HTTP 401 error message.
findings.impact: All API calls fail with HTTP 401 unless the X-API-Key header is sent.

findings.documented: Query parameter api_key is required; Bearer token is documented as optional and only needed for favourites.
findings.actual: Collection endpoints /v1/listings, /v1/rentals, and /v1/projects require BOTH the X-API-Key header AND an Authorization: Bearer <token> header from /auth/login. Calls without a Bearer token return 401 Unauthorized.
findings.how_found: Called GET /v1/listings with X-API-Key header alone and received HTTP 401.
findings.impact: Users cannot view listings, rentals, or projects without authenticating via /auth/login first.

findings.documented: Returns 'token', 'token_type': 'Bearer', 'expires_in': 86400 (24h), and states 'There is no refresh flow.'
findings.actual: Returns 'access_token' (not 'token'), 'refresh_token', 'refresh_url': '/auth/refresh', and 'expires_in': 900 (15 minutes). Session refresh flow exists via POST /auth/refresh taking {'refresh_token': '...'}.
findings.how_found: Inspected POST /auth/login response object keys and verified POST /auth/refresh endpoint.
findings.impact: Access tokens expire after 15 minutes instead of 24 hours. Applications must handle session refresh via /auth/refresh.

findings.documented: Every collection endpoint takes page (1-indexed) and limit (default 20, max 200). Response returns total, page, page_size, results.
findings.actual: Collection endpoints accept offset (0-indexed record offset) and limit (capped at max 50 items per page). The page parameter is ignored when limit is passed. Response metadata returns limit, offset, count, total, has_more, results.
findings.how_found: Tested page=2&limit=50 which returned offset 0 items repeatedly, whereas offset=50&limit=50 paginated correctly.
findings.impact: Clients using page parameter get stuck on page 1. Pagination must use offset parameter.

findings.documented: The endpoint total response field reports the exact number of records matching filters.
findings.actual: The total field in response metadata reports 3736 records, but paging to the end yields 4100 retrievable listing records.
findings.how_found: Paged through /v1/listings with offset += 50 until has_more was False.
findings.impact: Relying on the total metadata field truncates pagination math by 364 records.

findings.documented: GET /v1/listing/{listing_id} returns a single listing object.
findings.actual: GET /v1/listing/{listing_id} (singular) returns 404 Not Found. The working endpoint is GET /v1/listings/{listing_id} (plural).
findings.impact: Single listing lookup using documented singular route fails.

findings.documented: GET /v1/listings/{listing_id}/similar returns up to ten comparable listings.
findings.actual: GET /v1/listings/{listing_id}/similar returns 404 Not Found on the live server.
findings.how_found: Called GET /v1/listings/MAG-4001518/similar and received 404 Not Found.
findings.impact: Similar listings feature cannot rely on server endpoint.

findings.documented: GET /v1/favourites, POST /v1/favourites, and DELETE /v1/favourites/{id} manage saved listings.
findings.how_found: Called /v1/favourites with valid Bearer token and received 404 Not Found.
findings.impact: Favourites must be maintained client-side in localStorage or application state.

findings.documented: GET /v1/analytics/summary returns pre-computed aggregates for your city.
findings.how_found: Called GET /v1/analytics/summary with valid headers and received 404 Not Found.
findings.impact: Analytics dashboard metrics must be calculated directly from raw listing/project datasets.

findings.documented: price_min and price_max are in Indian rupees (integer).
findings.actual: price_min and price_max are reported as floats in Crores (for values < 15.0) or Lakhs (for values >= 15.0), rather than integer Rupees.
findings.how_found: Inspected project objects, e.g. P40224 reports price_max: 3.78 (3.78 Cr = 37,800,000 INR).
findings.impact: Displaying project prices without unit conversion displays ₹3.78 instead of ₹3.78 Cr.

findings.documented: carpet_area is in square feet everywhere in the API.
findings.actual: Listings from website magichomes report carpet_area and super_built_up_area in square meters (sq m) instead of square feet (e.g. 111 sq m for 3 BHK).
findings.how_found: Identified 3 BHK listings with carpet_area = 111 sq m.
findings.impact: Price per sqft calculations for magichomes listings are skewed unless converted to square feet.

findings.documented: Timestamps are ISO 8601, UTC, Z suffix, everywhere in the API.
findings.actual: posted_at in /v1/listings is an ISO string without Z suffix or timezone offset (e.g. '2026-01-19T12:56:00'), representing local server time (IST).
findings.how_found: Inspected posted_at values across all 4100 listing objects.
findings.impact: Parsing naive string as UTC shifts posted dates by -5:30 hours.

findings.documented: Every listing_id is globally unique and corresponds to exactly one physical property.
findings.actual: A set of 27 listing records contains physically impossible data (floor > total_floors, negative/zero prices, or carpet_area > super_built_up_area).
findings.how_found: Ran validation rules on floor vs total_floors, price, and carpet_area vs super_built_up_area.
findings.impact: Displays physically impossible properties unless filtered out.

findings.documented: Every listing is an active sale listing in your city.
findings.actual: 228 listing records belong to 12 lead-generation phone numbers that re-use 3 to 6 fake contact names across 7 to 10 localities to generate inquiries.
findings.how_found: Analyzed contact number multi-persona name distribution and locality geographic spread.
findings.impact: Distorts real estate marketplace pricing and availability.

findings.documented: total_listings in /v1/projects always agrees with what GET /v1/listings?project_id=... returns.
findings.actual: total_listings in project records disagrees with the actual number of listing records referencing that project for 336 out of 460 projects.
findings.how_found: Compared project.total_listings against count of listings referencing each project_id.
findings.impact: Project cards display inaccurate listing inventory counts.

findings.documented: Rental listing title and locality represent property location.
findings.actual: Rental listings contain contradictory locality information (e.g. title says '1 BHK for rent in Velachery' while locality field says 't nagar').
findings.how_found: Cross-referenced title string against locality attribute in rental objects.
findings.impact: Confuses users searching for rentals in specific localities.
